claims.text: Lag-two recurrence strongly enriched the mutation-generated memory-use allele under the one-proposal opportunity cost, while the recurrent-law ACTIVE minus SHAM accuracy contrast was bounded below the one-correct-bit scale with sign unresolved and the recurrence interaction in accuracy was unresolved.
claims.limits: One aligned recurrent law (HALF), one fixed cost, supplied cache architecture; the allele jointly controls cache retention and retrieval; population benefit not demonstrated.

claims.text: D_HALF = 0.000723 [-0.014898, 0.016343] and D_ZERO = -0.000096 [-0.015717, 0.015524] both lie inside (-1/32, +1/32); rule 2 not triggered. Stated as passage of the prespecified finite-horizon +/-1/32 start-state gate: late-window start contrasts bounded within one expected individual (95% familywise) over the 256-update horizon.
claims.limits: Gate passage at the one-individual scale over 256 updates only; not general start-independence, not a mutation-selection balance, not stationarity or equilibrium.

claims.text: P_abs = 0.009377 [-0.005138, 0.023892], BOUNDED BELOW THE POSITIVE ONE-BIT SCALE, sign unresolved; P_rec = 0.011360 [-0.017669, 0.040390], UNRESOLVED; secondary family cannot alter the primary decision.
claims.limits: P_abs is an ACTIVE-SHAM arm-level contrast within the model, not a path-level counterfactual; the P_rec half-width was fixed in the frozen specification.

claims.text: Under ZERO, start-averaged ACTIVE accuracy (0.605327) was descriptively below SHAM (0.607310), a contrast of -0.001983; no inferential bound was frozen.
The 16 absolute cell means (late-window memory-use frequency and accuracy for 8 cells) are descriptive only and are reported in full.

SHAM gives exact identities N1 and N2; start-averaged SHAM frequency is exactly 1/2 per block; expected start difference r^256 = 6.678005283720385e-08 and late-window average 9.57983820600146e-07 with r = 15/16. SHAM is an exact neutral benchmark for the label process and a paired control for query budget and keyed random draws; because ACTIVE genotypes and genealogies diverge at the first valid-M retrieval, it does not hold realised drift or genotype state fixed for ACTIVE paths.
claims.independent_check: check_statistics.py recomputes both neutral expressions in exact rational arithmetic and verifies N1/N2 on the saved means.

claims.text: 41,600 independent paired blocks, 8 cells per block, 332,800 paths, 85,196,800 path-updates and 10,905,190,400 objective queries; 22 saved estimate records; 0 post-outcome changes.

Separately written C++ replay (blocks 0-63; 512 paths; 16,777,216 audit rows) and Python record verification (all 41,600 blocks; 22 estimates) both returned PASS with zero mismatches. These are separately implemented internal reproducibility audits, not external peer review and not independent scientific replication. Producer and audit tools were both written with AI assistance from the same specification; the audits detect implementation divergence, not a shared misreading of the specification.

The opportunity cost is a model-specific search-budget trade-off (retrieval replaces one of two effectively uniform fresh proposals), not a calibrated energetic or biological cost; HALF matches the recurrence lag to the retrieval delay and favors retrieval by construction; no other lag, copy probability, cost, target process or model class was tested; the allele jointly determines cache retention and retrieval, so selection on the two is not separated.

Broad claims that memory evolves, predictability favors memory, or costly memory can evolve are occupied by prior work; the contribution is the joint design and a new implementation and cohort. Morgan, Suchow and Griffiths is described only as a close precedent among studies identified by the bounded search; no ranking or unique nearest precedent is claimed.
